title: 结构相同，名字不同
One structure, different names
text: 同构是保持运算的双射。先问是否保持乘法，再问是否一一对应；两个集合元素一样多只解决了后一件事。
An isomorphism is a bijection preserving multiplication. Equal cardinality alone says nothing about compatibility with the group operation.
example: ℤ₄ 的加法与四次单位根 {1,i,−1,−i} 的乘法同构：[k]↦iᵏ。
Addition in ℤ₄ is isomorphic to multiplication of fourth roots of unity via [k]↦iᵏ.

title: 单位元、逆元与元素的阶
Identity, inverses and orders
text: 同构保持单位元、逆元、整数幂以及元素的阶（包括无穷阶）。最后一条需要用到单射。
An isomorphism preserves identity, inverses, integer powers and element orders, including infinite order. Equality of orders uses injectivity.
proof: f(e)=f(e)f(e)，在目标群中消去可得 f(e)=e。
Cancel in f(e)=f(e)f(e) to obtain f(e)=e.
由 f(a)f(a⁻¹)=f(e)=e 得 f(a⁻¹)=f(a)⁻¹；归纳并结合逆元，得到 f(aᵐ)=f(a)ᵐ。
Use f(a)f(a⁻¹)=e to obtain preservation of inverses; induction gives preservation of all integer powers.
f(a)ᵐ=e 当且仅当 f(aᵐ)=f(e)，由单射当且仅当 aᵐ=e。因此最小正指数相同，或两边都不存在。
By injectivity, f(a)ᵐ=e if and only if aᵐ=e. The least positive exponent is therefore identical, or absent on both sides.

title: 如何证明不同构
How to disprove an isomorphism
text: 群的阶、交换性、各阶元素的个数都是同构不变量。找到一个不变量不同，就能排除同构；不变量一致通常不能保证同构。
Order, commutativity and the number of elements of each order are isomorphism invariants. A mismatch rules out isomorphism; agreement alone usually does not establish it.
example: C₄ 有两个 4 阶元素；C₂×C₂ 的三个非单位元都为 2 阶。因此两者虽然都只有四个元素，却不同构。
C₄ has two elements of order 4. All three nonidentity elements of C₂×C₂ have order 2. Thus these groups of order 4 are not isomorphic.

title: 逆映射与复合同构
Inverses and compositions
entries.tex: G\cong G,\quad G\cong H\Rightarrow H\cong G,\quad G\cong H\cong K\Rightarrow G\cong K
text: 群的同构关系是等价关系。建立同构时，可以借助更熟悉的中间模型。
Isomorphism is an equivalence relation. A familiar intermediate model can help construct an isomorphism.
proof: 恒等映射是保持乘法的双射，给出反身性。
The identity map is a multiplication-preserving bijection.
若 f 为同构，写 u=f(a)、v=f(b)，则 f⁻¹(uv)=f⁻¹(f(ab))=ab=f⁻¹(u)f⁻¹(v)。逆映射也为双射。
For an isomorphism f, write u=f(a), v=f(b). Then f⁻¹(uv)=ab=f⁻¹(u)f⁻¹(v), so its inverse is an isomorphism.
两个双射的复合是双射，且 (g∘f)(ab)=g(f(a)f(b))=g(f(a))g(f(b))。
A composite of bijections is bijective, and the composite also preserves multiplication.

title: 凯莱定理
Cayley’s theorem
text: 每个群都同构于一个置换群。有限群 G 若有 n 个元素，就同构于 Sₙ 的某个子群。这里不是断言 G 同构于整个 Sₙ。
Every group is isomorphic to a permutation group. A group of order n is isomorphic to a subgroup of Sₙ, not necessarily to Sₙ itself.
proof: 左乘 λ_g 是 G 到自身的双射，其逆映射是 λ_(g⁻¹)。
Left multiplication λ_g is a bijection with inverse λ_(g⁻¹).
对每个 x，λ_(gh)(x)=(gh)x=g(hx)=(λ_g∘λ_h)(x)，所以 g↦λ_g 保持乘法。
Associativity gives λ_(gh)=λ_g∘λ_h.
若 λ_g=λ_h，在 e 处求值就得 g=h，因此映射单射。
Evaluate λ_g=λ_h at e to obtain g=h; the map is injective.
像对复合和逆映射封闭，是 Sym(G) 的子群；G 与这个像同构。
The image is a subgroup of Sym(G), and G is isomorphic to this image.

title: 任意非空集合上的群结构
Group structures on nonempty sets
text: 在选择公理下，每个非空集合 X 上都存在一种二元运算，使 X 成为交换群。
Assuming the axiom of choice, every nonempty set X admits a binary operation making X an abelian group.
已知群 (H,·) 和双射 f:X→H。先送过去相乘，再用逆映射送回来。这是整个构造的核心。
Given a group (H,·) and a bijection f:X→H, multiply in H and transport the result back. This is the central construction.
乘积属于 H；双射的逆映射在整个 H 上有定义且取值唯一。因此运算确实落在 X 中。
The product is in H, and the inverse bijection is defined uniquely on all of H. Thus the operation takes values in X.
先比较两种括号在 f 下的像。使用 H 的结合律，再使用 f 的单射性。
Compare the images under f. Use associativity in H, followed by injectivity of f.
两行右端相等，因此两种括号给出同一个元素。
The right-hand sides agree, so the two bracketings give the same element.
把 H 的单位元搬回来；分别验证左右两边。
Transport the identity of H and check both sides.
先在 H 中取逆，再搬回 X。
Take the inverse in H, then transport it back.
f 本来就是双射；运算的定义使它保持乘法。因此 f 是群同构。若 H 交换，则 X 也交换。
The given bijection preserves multiplication by construction, hence is an isomorphism. If H is abelian, so is X.

title: 02 · 有限集合：搬运模 n 加法
02 · Finite sets: transport addition modulo n

text: 若 X={x₀,…,xₙ₋₁}，n≥1，使用双射 f(xᵢ)=[i] 到 ℤ/nℤ。定义如下；我们创造新运算，不要求保留集合原有的运算。
For X={x₀,…,xₙ₋₁}, n≥1, use f(xᵢ)=[i] into ℤ/nℤ. This defines a new operation, without preserving any prior operation.
例如给红、蓝、绿依次编号 0、1、2，就有“蓝乘蓝等于绿、蓝乘绿等于红”。
For red, blue and green indexed by 0,1,2, blue times blue is green, while blue times green is red.

title: 验证群公理及交换性
Verify the group axioms and commutativity

text: 模 n 余数仍在指定编号内，给出封闭性；整数加法的结合律给出下面等式。
Residues remain in the index set, giving closure; associativity of integer addition gives the equality below.
单位元、逆元和交换性分别为：
The identity, inverses and commutativity are:
n=1 时仍然成立，得到单元素群。
The construction also works for n=1, giving the trivial group.

title: 03 · 无限集合：有限子集与对称差
03 · Infinite sets: finite subsets and symmetric difference

text: 先不要直接在 X 上猜运算。取所有有限子集组成的新集合；它的元素是集合，包含空集。
Do not guess an operation on X directly. First use the set of its finite subsets; its elements are sets, including the empty set.
运算只保留恰好出现在一个集合中的元素。注意：此时构造的是 F(X) 上的群，还不是 X 上的群。
Keep exactly those elements that occur in one of the two sets. At this stage the group is on F(X), not on X.
两个有限集的并有限，对称差是这个并集的子集，所以仍然有限。
The union of two finite sets is finite, and the symmetric difference is a subset of this union.
blocks.tex: A\triangle B\subseteq A\cup B\ \Longrightarrow\ A\triangle B\in\mathcal F(X).

title: 验证结合律：逐点看奇偶性
Verify associativity: pointwise parity

text: 固定 t∈X，用指示函数记录 t 是否属于一个集合。
Fix t∈X and use indicator functions to record membership.
两种括号都给出同一个模 2 的和。指示函数只取 0、1，因此模 2 相等就是相等。对所有 t 都成立，集合便相等。
Both bracketings give the same sum modulo 2. Since indicators take only 0 and 1, congruence implies equality. Equality at every t gives equality of sets.
空集是有限集，且是双侧单位元。
The empty set is finite and is a two-sided identity.
每个元素都是自己的逆元。
Every element is its own inverse.
交换两个集合不改变对称差。
Swapping the sets leaves the symmetric difference unchanged.

title: 04 · 用集合论事实，把群搬回 X
04 · Use the cardinality fact and return to X

text: 集合论工具箱提供：在选择公理下，无限集合 X 与 F(X) 等势。先把这条事实当作接口使用；证明可在下方按需展开。
The toolbox supplies this fact: assuming choice, an infinite set X is equipotent to F(X). Use the fact here; expand its proof below if needed.
取双射 f:X→F(X)，调用第一步的搬运构造。于是任意非空集合都能赋予交换群结构。
Choose a bijection f:X→F(X) and apply Step 01. Together with the finite case, every nonempty set admits an abelian group structure.

title: 核对单位元、逆元与元素阶
Check identity, inverses and element orders

text: 封闭性与结合律已由第一步及第三步验证。现在将单位元与逆元公式具体化。
Closure and associativity follow from Steps 01 and 03. Specialize the identity and inverse formulas.
除单位元外，每个元素都恰为 2 阶。因而无限情形下，这个群不是循环群：每个单个元素至多生成两个元素。这个结论只针对本构造，不是说所有群都如此。
Every nonidentity element has order exactly 2. Thus this infinite group is not cyclic: one element generates at most two elements. This describes this construction, not all groups.

title: 05 · 一个可计算的例子：自然数的异或群
05 · A computable example: the XOR group

text: 将自然数 n 对应到它的二进制展开中数字 1 所在的位置。此时不必抽象地选择双射。
Map n to the positions of the 1s in its binary expansion. Here the bijection is explicit.
blocks.tex: \begin{gathered}f:\mathbb N_0\longrightarrow\mathcal F(\mathbb N_0),\\f(n)=\{k:\text{the binary digit of }n\text{ at }k\text{ is }1\},\\f^{-1}(A)=\sum_{k\in A}2^k.\end{gathered}

text: 新运算是逐位异或，而不是普通加法。例如：
The new operation is bitwise XOR, not ordinary addition. For example:

title: 核对双射与群性质
Check the bijection and group properties

text: 二进制展开的存在与唯一性保证两个映射互逆；每个自然数只有有限多个非零位。对称差对应逐位模 2 相加，故第一步和第三步的全部验证适用。
Existence and uniqueness of finite binary expansions make the two maps inverse. Symmetric difference becomes digitwise addition modulo 2, so all checks from Steps 01 and 03 apply.

title: 良序与选择公理：实数不是按原来的大小排列
Well-orders and choice: a new order on the reals

text: 全序关系 ≼ 满足自反性、反对称性、传递性，并且任意两元素可比较。良序还要求每个非空子集都有最小元素；不仅是整个集合有最小元素。
A total order is reflexive, antisymmetric, transitive and compares every pair. A well-order additionally gives a least element to every nonempty subset, not just to the whole set.
blocks.tex: \forall\varnothing\ne A\subseteq X\ \exists a_0\in A\ \forall a\in A:\ a_0\preceq a.

text: 选择公理保证每个集合可良序化。整数的通常次序不是良序，但下面的新次序是：
Choice ensures that every set can be well-ordered. The usual order on the integers is not a well-order, but the following new order is:
实数也可赋予良序 ≺，但不是通常大小关系 <。若 r 是 (0,1) 在新良序中的最小元素，则以下两句同时成立，没有矛盾。良序的存在并不在这里提供一个具体比较规则。

The reals admit a well-order ≺, different from their usual order <. If r is the ≺-least point of (0,1), both statements below hold. This existence result does not supply a concrete comparison rule here.
实数不可数，不能排成 r₀,r₁,… 这样的自然数列表。良序的位置由序数描述；基数可取为相应大小的最小序数，称初始序数。
The reals cannot be listed using natural-number positions. Ordinals describe well-order types; a cardinal is represented by the least ordinal of its size, called an initial ordinal.

title: 映射证明：无限基数 κ×κ 与 κ 等势
Mapping proof: κ×κ is equipotent to infinite κ

text: 把 κ 视为初始序数，对无限基数归纳：假定每个无限 λ<κ 已有双射 bλ。目标是构造 κ×κ→κ 的单射，反向用 α↦(α,0)。
Regard κ as an initial ordinal and induct on infinite cardinals. Assume bijections bλ for infinite λ<κ. Construct an injection κ×κ→κ; the reverse injection is α↦(α,0).
对 p=(α,β)，按下列三元组的字典序给所有有序对排序。任意非空子集可依次取最小的最大坐标、第一坐标、第二坐标，所以确实是良序。
Order pairs by the following triples lexicographically. Successively minimizing the maximum coordinate, then the first and second coordinates, proves this is a well-order.
固定 p，令 δ=max{α,β}，Pp 为排在 p 前面的有序对集合。取 λ=|δ+1|<κ 及双射 u。
Fix p, put δ=max{α,β}, and let Pp be its predecessor set. Set λ=|δ+1|<κ and choose a bijection u.
这里 δ+1<κ 是因为无限初始序数是极限序数：任何无限序数 γ 都与 γ+1 等势。具体双射将新增的最后元素 γ 送到 0，将自然数 n 送到 n+1，其余元素固定。故无限后继序数不可能是初始序数。

Here δ+1<κ because an infinite initial ordinal is a limit ordinal. For any infinite ordinal γ, a bijection γ+1→γ sends the added last element γ to 0, each natural n to n+1, and fixes the other elements. Thus an infinite successor cannot be initial.
如果 λ 无限，用归纳假设定义 Ep；如果 λ=n 有限，用商余数编码。两种都是单射，目标 νp 均严格小于 κ。
For infinite λ use the inductive bijection; for finite λ=n use quotient–remainder coding. Both define injections into νp<κ.
令 ρp 为 Pp 的次序类型，rp 是保序双射。下面的复合为单射，因此 |ρp|<κ；κ 是初始序数，所以 ρp<κ。
Let ρp be the order type of Pp and rp its order isomorphism. This composite is injective, so |ρp|<κ; initiality of κ gives ρp<κ.
定义 J(p)=ρp。若 p≺q，则 rq 限制到 Pp 后是到序数 rq(p) 的保序双射，故 ρp=rq(p)<ρq。这证明 J 单射。
Define J(p)=ρp. If p≺q, restricting rq to Pp gives an order isomorphism onto rq(p), so ρp=rq(p)<ρq. Thus J is injective.
对 I、J 使用下方的双向单射定理即得双射。κ=ℵ₀ 时，上述 λ 都有限，因此归纳起点已经包含在构造内。这是集合等势，不是序数乘法恒等式。
Apply Cantor–Bernstein below to I and J. For κ=ℵ₀ all λ above are finite, so the base case needs no inductive hypothesis. This concerns cardinality, not ordinal multiplication.

title: 为什么 ℕ₀×κ 与 κ 等势
Why ℕ₀×κ is equipotent to κ

text: κ 无限，故 ω≤κ，每个自然数可看作 κ 的元素。取上一事实的双射 q，定义两个方向的单射。
For infinite κ, ω≤κ, so natural numbers are elements of κ. Using the preceding bijection q, define injections in both directions.
i 单射显然；j 的单射性来自 q。双向单射定理给出等势。若 κ 是非零有限基数，结论不成立。
The first map is plainly injective; injectivity of j follows from q. Cantor–Bernstein gives equipotence. The result fails for nonzero finite κ.

title: 为什么可数个 κ 大小的集合之并仍为 κ
Why a countable union of κ-sized sets has size κ

text: 设 |Aₙ|≤κ，U=⋃ₙAₙ。在选择公理下选定单射 fₙ:Aₙ→κ。集合可以重叠：给每个 x 选它第一次出现的编号。
Assume |Aₙ|≤κ and U=⋃ₙAₙ. By choice select injections fₙ:Aₙ→κ. The sets may overlap: assign each x its first index.
F(x)=F(y) 首先给出相同编号 n，再由 fₙ 单射得 x=y。因此 |U|≤κ。若至少一个 Aₘ 的大小为 κ，包含映射 Aₘ→U 给出反向不等式，故 |U|=κ。
Equality of F-images gives the same index n and then x=y by injectivity of fₙ. Thus |U|≤κ. If some Aₘ has size κ, inclusion Aₘ→U gives the reverse inequality, hence equality.
设 X 无限，|X|=κ。由平方基数事实归纳得到每个正整数 n 都满足 κⁿ=κ。固定 X 的良序，将有限子集按此良序排列编码。
For infinite X of size κ, induction from κ²=κ gives κⁿ=κ for every positive integer n. Fix a well-order of X and encode each finite subset in increasing order.
令 Sₙ 为所有带长度标签的 n 元组的集合。S₀ 只有空序列标签，其余每个 Sₙ 都有 κ 个元素。可数并事实说明 ⋃ₙSₙ 有 κ 个元素，且上述编码为单射。反方向使用 x↦{x}。

Let Sₙ be the set of length-tagged n-tuples. S₀ has one empty-tuple tag; each other Sₙ has size κ. The countable-union fact gives size κ for ⋃ₙSₙ, and the encoding is injective. In the other direction use x↦{x}.
由双向单射定理得到所需双射。不能换成全部子集：Cantor 定理给出 |P(X)|>|X|。
Cantor–Bernstein supplies the desired bijection. Do not replace finite subsets by all subsets: Cantor’s theorem gives |P(X)|>|X|.

title: 双向单射定理：写出双射并验证
Cantor–Bernstein: define and verify the bijection

text: 给定单射 i:A→B、j:B→A，定义以下集合。
Given injections i:A→B and j:B→A, define:
在 C 上沿 i，在其余部分沿 j 的逆映射。a∉C 推出 a∉A₀，因此 a∈j(B)，第二分支定义良好。
Use i on C and the inverse of j elsewhere. If a∉C, then a∉A₀ and hence a∈j(B), so the second branch is defined.
单射：两个分支各自单射。若跨分支相等，即 i(a)=j⁻¹(a′)，其中 a∈C、a′∉C，则 a′=j(i(a))∈C，矛盾。
Injectivity: both branches are injective. Equality across branches, i(a)=j⁻¹(a′) with a∈C and a′∉C, would give a′=j(i(a))∈C, a contradiction.
满射：给定 b∈B。若 j(b)∉C，则 h(j(b))=b。否则 j(b)∈C 且不在 A₀，所以属于某个 Aₙ₊₁=j(i(Aₙ))；存在 a∈Aₙ 使 j(b)=j(i(a))，由 j 单射得 b=i(a)=h(a)。
Surjectivity: for b∈B, if j(b)∉C then h(j(b))=b. Otherwise j(b)∈C but not A₀, hence lies in some Aₙ₊₁=j(i(Aₙ)). Choose a∈Aₙ with j(b)=j(i(a)); injectivity of j gives b=i(a)=h(a).

title: 自同构与内自同构
Automorphisms and inner automorphisms
text: G 到自身的同构称为自同构，它们在映射复合下构成群。共轭映射 c_g 是特别重要的自同构。
An automorphism is an isomorphism from G to itself. Automorphisms form a group under composition; conjugation gives important examples.
proof: c_g(xy)=gxyg⁻¹=(gxg⁻¹)(gyg⁻¹)，故保持乘法。
Insert g⁻¹g between x and y to see that c_g preserves products.
c_(g⁻¹) 是 c_g 的逆映射，因此 c_g 是双射。
Conjugation by g⁻¹ is its inverse, so c_g is bijective.
恒等映射、复合与逆映射均为自同构；映射复合满足结合律，故 Aut(G) 为群。
Identity, composition and inversion preserve automorphisms; composition is associative.

question: ℤ₄ 与 C₂×C₂ 不同构，最直接的理由是什么？
Why are ℤ₄ and C₂×C₂ not isomorphic?
options: 只有前者有 4 阶元素
Only the former has an element of order 4
reason: 同构保持元素阶；两个群都为四阶且交换。
Isomorphisms preserve element orders. Both groups have order four and are abelian.

question: f:ℤ→2ℤ，f(k)=2k，在加法下是？
Under addition, f:ℤ→2ℤ, k↦2k is?
reason: 目标是 2ℤ，所以 f 既单又满，并且保持加法。
The codomain is 2ℤ; f is bijective and additive.

question: 凯莱定理为 n 阶群 G 给出什么？
What does Cayley’s theorem give for a group of order n?
options: G 同构于 Sₙ 的子群
G is isomorphic to a subgroup of Sₙ
reason: 左正则表示是单射，其像通常只是 Sₙ 的子群。
The left regular representation is injective; its image need not be all of Sₙ.

question: 映射 x↦x⁻¹ 对任意群都是自同构吗？
Is inversion an automorphism of every group?
reason: (xy)⁻¹=y⁻¹x⁻¹。保持乘法等价于所有 x⁻¹、y⁻¹ 交换，也就等价于 G 交换。
Inversion reverses multiplication. It preserves products exactly when the group is abelian.

question: 构造 (ℝ,+) 与 (ℝ>0,×) 的同构，并核对三项条件。
Construct an isomorphism (ℝ,+)→(ℝ>0,×) and check its properties.
reason: 取 f(x)=exp(x)。exp(x+y)=exp(x)exp(y)，严格单调给出单射，每个正数有实对数给出满射。
Use f(x)=exp(x). It preserves the operation, is injective by strict monotonicity, and is onto by the existence of real logarithms.
